name: popsicle
headline: Digitalworld: Digital Marketing Fundamentals
short_description: DIGITAL    MARKETING      BY SARA ATIQ                                  INTRODUCTION      “It is a marketing technique that involves usage of digital mediums such as internet & wireless for creating awareness, consideration, purchase & loyalty for a brand product or a service". It is the term used to describe any marketing efforts that place on the internet or a digital device. It has different channels that enable the business to entice their customer into buying their product
author: digisarah14

sections.overview:
Digitalworld provides a comprehensive introduction to digital marketing techniques and their application across multiple channels. The resource covers traffic acquisition methods including search engine marketing, social media marketing, email marketing, display advertising, and affiliate marketing. It also addresses supporting channels such as mobile marketing, websites, and web analytics. The skill outlines a process framework based on four core marketing objectives: awareness, consideration, purchase, and loyalty. This makes it suitable for marketers and business professionals seeking to understand how digital mediums enable brand building and customer acquisition.
Building a multi-channel digital marketing strategy for product launches
Understanding search engine marketing and paid advertising for visibility
Planning social media and email campaigns to drive customer engagement
Analyzing website performance and user behavior through web analytics
